menu_deck_NEWDECK_desc: An example perk deck, to help modders learn to make custom perk decks.
menu_deck_NEWDECK_1_desc:
You and your team gain ##+100%## knowledge of ##the rules##.

You are ##90%## less likely to be given up.
menu_deck_NEWDECK_3_desc: You are ##75%## less likely to be let down.
menu_deck_NEWDECK_5_desc: You are ##15%## less likely to be ##hurt## by someone ##running around## or ##deserting you.##
menu_deck_NEWDECK_7_desc: Your team can no longer ##make you cry##.
menu_deck_NEWDECK_9_desc:
You are ##45%## less likely to be ##hurt## by someone ##saying goodbye## or someone ##telling a lie##.

You also gain an additional ##45%## chance for someone to ##desert you.##
bm_grenade_THROWABLE_NAME_desc:
A blackmarket description for your throwable goes here.
The throwable does nothing.
bm_menu_skill_locked_THROWABLE_NAME: You must have the Example Perk Deck equipped!
